description: The right plot in Figure 1 compares the loss of the vanilla Transformer and the proposed SepLLM model over training time. The x-axis represents the training time in seconds, ranging from 0 to 250,000, with major tick marks at intervals of 50,000. The y-axis represents the loss, ranging from 2.40 to 2.75, with major tick marks at intervals of 0.05. Two lines are plotted: a purple dashed line for the vanilla Transformer and a red solid line for SepLLM. Both lines start at a loss of approximately 2.75 at a training time of 0 seconds. As training time increases, both models show a decreasing loss. The SepLLM model (red line) consistently achieves a lower loss than the vanilla Transformer (purple line) across the entire training period. At the end of the training, at 250,000 seconds, the loss for SepLLM is approximately 2.50, while the loss for the vanilla Transformer is approximately 2.55. The plot includes a label indicating a 1.26x improvement for SepLLM.
